data.title: vhs/: BRANDING.md — skeuomorphic TV+VCR direction (FF-to-navigate, hazy screen overlay for videos)

data.body: Impl done (commit f67781d): vhs/BRANDING.md only, per plan. Notable choices: (1) CONTACTS segment declared a no-video-slot sacred zone — links always on flat measured VCR Blue #0000AA (11.9:1), never composited over video; (2) all contrast ratios computed (node one-liner), incl. scrim worst case rgb(4 4 22/.82) over pure-white video frame = #313140 -> 11.4:1; (3) single VT323 @import has no raw ';' today — %3B gotcha restated for future edits; (4) haze layer alphas hard-capped and tied to the contrast contract; (5) no-JS baseline specced (segments stack, tube content area scrolls). Post-write hook requested brand-page regeneration of vhs/index.html — deliberately NOT done, out of scope per plan (separate later task).

REVIEW (cold, against plan task_01KZJF3SESPBNJ6XGTBN8N644E + commit f67781d): PASS. (1) Scope: commit touches only vhs/BRANDING.md (796 lines, on par with slop 822 / iphone 691). (2) All four user-concept clauses are load-bearing: TV+VCR skeuomorphism (law 1, §4 cabinet recipes with overhead-light molding discipline), FF-as-navigation (law 2, §6 transport semantics + keyboard + shuttle), hazy overlay above all screen content (law 3, §5 codified 7-layer stack with alpha caps), videos-added-later (§6 degradation rule: absolute /vhs/ paths, purpose-built stand-ins, no-JS-detection, page ships complete with zero video files). (3) WCAG table spot-checked in node — all 11 ratios correct to the decimal, including the scrim-over-white composite (#313140 -> 11.47 vs claimed 11.4); hard legibility rule + plate rule present. (4) Build-contract restatement in §9 matches CLAUDE.md authoring contract exactly: @import at top + %3B gotcha, at-rule whitelist, vhs- prefix on ids/keyframes/fonts (all keyframes in doc are prefixed), no commas in functional pseudo-classes, no display on html/body, SITES['vhs'] registry with root-only queries and no styles on root, standalone boot line, page-never-scrolls with tube-owned overflow, isolation:isolate for the blend layer (marble precedent). No contradictions found; the reduced-motion selector list uses top-level commas, which the contract permits. (5) House format mirrors iphone/: blockquote framing, three laws + Voice, token tables + :root, one-hard-rule contrast, surface recipes with gotcha callouts, sanctioned-motion table + mandatory prefers-reduced-motion composed frame, What-this-is-not table, Page application with owner links (GitHub @malls, Twitter @forrestalmasi, _@forrestalmasi.com) under a sacred no-video flat-blue treatment, and a checkable The-test list. Bonus beyond plan: no-JS stacked baseline specced as required. Verified vhs-track math (1900% of 6% band = 114% travel). No inline fixes needed. Meets all acceptance criteria — moving to done.
